of.needed: whether existing EC2NodeClass objects are still stored as v1beta1 (status.storedVersions of the ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws CRD)

consequence.statement: Existing EC2NodeClass objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. They must be migrated to v1, and status.storedVersions updated, before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Run a storage version migration that rewrites all EC2NodeClass objects, then update status.storedVersions on the ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws CRD.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1. Existing EC2NodeClass objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten, so a storage version migration and an update of status.storedVersions are needed before a later release removes v1beta1.
